purpose: Post-primary diagnostic of failed absolute Hessian qualification; not a replacement gate or target-blind check
selection: For each case, select two distinct columns with largest max-absolute original coarse/fine discrepancy; retain the exposed worst row for each column
observable: Fresh projected-force central derivative for each selected column; track full-column successive max differences and worst-entry values
scope: Two selected columns do not qualify the full Hessian; no frozen tolerance is changed and original failures remain
